title: Bootstrapped 8年，他以3250万美元卖掉公司
title_jp: 8年間自力運営、3250万ドルで売却
title_ar: 8 سنوات تمويل ذاتي، باع بـ32.5 مليون دولار
carouselChartTitle: Bootstrapped 8年，他以3250万美元卖掉公司
author: 阿星
content:
{"ops": [{"insert": "Bootstrapped 8年，他以3250万美元卖掉公司"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他说：最好的出售时机，是你不需要卖的时候", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Eran Galperin做了8年Gymdesk。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一个给健身房和武术学校用的管理软件。完全bootstrapped。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2024年5月，卖了3250万美元。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他说："我从没想过会卖公司，更别说卖这么多。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Eran学物理出身，后来做freelance开发。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2010年联合创立了一个VC公司，拿了种子轮，但没长大到能继续融资。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他想试试不同的路——bootstrapped。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "想focus on B2B SaaS，考虑了几个垂直领域，最后选了自己热爱的——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "巴西柔术。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从2006年开始认真练，想把爱好和专业结合。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "产品最初叫"Martial Arts on Rails"，只做武术学校。后来扩展到健身房、瑜伽馆、体操馆等。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "二、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "技术栈很朴实。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "LNMP（Linux/Nginx/MySQL/PHP），Zend Framework。前端jQuery和vanilla JS。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "都是他用熟了的stack，之前的项目有scaffolding，能快速迭代，不需要外部资源。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "设计花了3000美元，部署在Digital Ocean专用服务器上。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在快9年了，产品还在一台专用服务器上跑。 hosting费用大概400美元/月。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "（最近在加冗余/故障转移）"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "花了4个月上线，2016年4月发布。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后3-4个月才发现——不知道怎么获客。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "为了生存，他接了一些contract work，还当了DTC电商公司的CTO。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2019年才全职做Gymdesk，那时产品收入已经超过全职工资了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "那段时间，他养成了精细化的客户反馈流程。周末持续改进产品，不断扩大scope。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2020年初才真正找到PMF", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "，开始显著增长。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "年初月入1.2万，年底涨到2万——尽管有疫情。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "四、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2023年底，Gymdesk做到290万美元ARR。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Eran开始和PE公司谈收购。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "为什么这时候卖？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""最好的出售时机，是你不需要卖的时候。"", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们有扎实的基本面：低流失率、稳定增长、高客户满意度。加上收入里程碑，让他们能拿到高multiple。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他的建议："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "1. 先练好基本功", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "业务越好，deal越好。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2. 把自己从业务中分离出来", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "卖之前两年就开始这个process。当收到inbound interest时，就开始准备。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "3. 找个好的sell-side broker", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "第一次卖的话，这极其重要。再加一个有经验的M&A lawyer。这两个是主要支持。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他在博客上详细写了出售流程，技术且复杂，有兴趣可以去看。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "五、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "获客怎么做的？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "早期靠个人关系，行业里的人。用完contact list后，不知道怎么找客户了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " visibility 是主要问题。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "试过outreach和guest blogging，基本没效果。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "唯一管用一点的是Capterra等软件比较网站上的小量PPC投放。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但他持续投资内容和SEO，熟悉的渠道。随着时间，这成了主要获客渠道，60%+ leads来自这里。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "SaaS的SEO是缓慢且折磨的过程，但一旦开始work，和PLG/self-service模式很匹配。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "后来又加了integration合作、推荐、reseller等渠道。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "六、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Eran最初犯了个错误——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "试图把营销和销售外包给外部agency和contractor。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "学到的教训是：这些人大多只套用标准playbook，没有 nuanced understanding of your business and audience。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他现在坚信："}, {"insert": "创始人要自己搞懂营销，到能理解并能有效外包某些方面的程度。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "定价也调整过。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "传统订阅制，按会员数和场地数阶梯定价。2022年重组了定价计划，显著提升了收入增长。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "大部分创始人定价偏低，且因为怕upset客户而不敢动。他们也这样很久，现在还没完全optimal。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "另外，支付量也带来显著收入，和Stripe、Square等支付伙伴的分成协议。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他花了些时间才理解 platform 处理量的价值，建议任何处理支付的产品都要认真看这个。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "七、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "成功靠两件事："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Focus on product + customer satisfaction。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "处理客户反馈有两种方式："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "投资support资源：文档、support reps、培训等", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "投资产品，让事情更简单易懂", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "早期他 heavily optimize 后者，更在他的wheelhouse。后来也大幅投资support基础设施，因为单人是有限度的。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这种对满意度的obsession，推动他们走到今天。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "八、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他的核心建议："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "学会有效prioritize。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "做你不擅长的事，直到擅长。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "营销他就是这么学会的。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最艰难的stretch是最初2-3年，钱紧，每周都有火要灭。成功很大程度上是 perseverance 撑过那段时间，并持续从错误中学习，更高效地运营。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他推荐Rob Walling的The SaaS Playbook，满是B2B SaaS的tactical advice。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "写在最后"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Eran的故事是bootstrapped success的经典案例。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "8年，从0到290万ARR，然后 life-changing exit。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "没有融资，没有疯狂增长，就是稳扎稳打。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "关键是什么？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "扎实的 fundamentals。低流失、稳定增长、客户满意。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "还有耐心。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他说卖完后还有rollover equity，会继续关注公司post-sale的成长。同时开始天使投资和mentor早期B2B SaaS公司。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这才是真正的财富自由——不只是钱，是选择和掌控。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "原文来自Indie Hackers，由AI翻译并改写", "attributes": {"italic": true}}]}
content_en: Bootstrapped eight years he sold company for thirty two million five hundred thousand dollars. He said best time to sell is when you do not need to sell. Eran Galperin did eight years Gymdesk. Software for gyms and martial arts schools. Completely bootstrapped. May twenty twenty four sold for thirty two million five hundred thousand dollars. He said I never thought would sell company let alone for this much. One. Eran studied physics later did freelance development. Twenty ten co-founded VC company got seed round but did not grow big enough to continue fundraising. He wanted to try different path bootstrapped. Wanted focus on B2B SaaS considered several vertical fields finally chose what he loved. Brazilian jiu jitsu. Started seriously practicing from twenty six wanted to combine hobby and profession. Product initially called Martial Arts on Rails only for martial arts schools. Later expanded to gyms yoga studios gymnastics gyms etc. Two. Tech stack is simple. LNMP Linux Nginx MySQL PHP Zend Framework. Frontend jQuery and vanilla JS. All stacks he used before previous projects had scaffolding could iterate quickly no outside.
